cards.ex: I can't be sure, but I'd hazard a guess that the company will be sold soon.
cards.exUz: Aniq ayta olmayman, lekin kompaniya tez orada sotiladi deb taxmin qilaman.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsa haqida ishonchsiz yoki aniq bo'lmagan holda taxmin qilish.

cards.ex: He knew he'd broken the law, and eventually he had to face the music.
cards.exUz: U qonunni buzganini bilardi va oxir-oqibat javobgarlikka tortilishi kerak edi.
cards.uzDef: Xatolar yoki noto'g'ri xatti-harakatlar uchun javobgarlikni qabul qilish.

cards.ex: Driving that fast on icy roads is just courting disaster.
cards.exUz: Muzli yo'llarda bunday tez haydash shunchaki halokatga yo'l ochishdir.
cards.uzDef: Ehtimoliy halokat yoki muammoga olib keladigan xatti-harakatlarni qilish.

cards.ex: He enjoys living on the edge, skydiving and racing motorcycles.
cards.exUz: U xavf ostida yashashni, osmonda sakrashni va mototsiklda poyga qilishni yaxshi ko'radi.
cards.uzDef: Xavfli yoki hayajonli hayot tarzini kechirish.

cards.ex: The government provides a safety net for the unemployed.
cards.exUz: Hukumat ishsizlar uchun xavfsizlik tarmog'ini taqdim etadi.
cards.uzDef: Agar yomon narsa yuz bersa, yordam beradigan resurslar yoki odamlar.

cards.ex: In that part of the city, danger lurks around every corner.
cards.exUz: Shaharning bu qismida har burchakda xavf yashiringan.
cards.uzDef: Xavf yashirin holatda mavjud va paydo bo'lishi mumkin.

cards.ex: Investing in that startup was a calculated risk, but it paid off.
cards.exUz: O'sha startapga sarmoya kiritish hisoblangan xavf edi, ammo u o'zini oqladi.
cards.uzDef: Foyda olish uchun qilingan, ammo potentsial zararlari baholangan xavf.

cards.ex: Driving without insurance is like playing Russian roulette with your finances.
cards.exUz: Sug'urtasiz haydash moliyangiz bilan ruletka o'ynash bilan barobar.
cards.uzDef: Biroz o'lim bilan o'ynash kabi, o'ta xavfli harakat qilish.

cards.ex: With the company's future at stake, everyone needs to work harder.
cards.exUz: Kompaniyaning kelajagi xavf ostida ekan, hamma ko'proq ishlashi kerak.
cards.uzDef: Yo'qotilishi yoki xavfga qo'yilishi mumkin bo'lgan narsa.

cards.ex: I don't know if it will work, but I'm going to take a punt and apply for the job.
cards.exUz: Ishlaydimi yo'qmi bilmayman, lekin men tavakkal qilib ishga ariza topshiraman.
cards.uzDef: Aniqlik bo'lmasa ham, biror narsaga urinib ko'rmoq.

cards.ex: He's really out on a limb supporting that controversial policy.
cards.exUz: U o'sha bahsli siyosatni qo'llab-quvvatlab, o'zini xavf ostiga qo'ydi.
cards.uzDef: Boshqalardan farqli fikrni qo'llab-quvvatlash orqali o'zingni xavf ostiga qo'yish.

cards.ex: The valuable artifacts are kept under lock and key in the museum.
cards.exUz: Qimmatbaho asarlar muzeyda qulf ostida saqlanadi.
cards.uzDef: Xavfsizlik uchun qulflangan va himoyalangan holda saqlanadigan narsa.

cards.ex: We need to nip these rumors in the bud before they damage the company's reputation.
cards.exUz: Bu mish-mishlarni kompaniya obro'siga zarar yetkazmasdan oldin oldini olishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Katta muammoga aylanmasdan oldin yoqimsiz narsani to'xtatish.

cards.ex: Don't take everything he says at face value; he tends to exaggerate.
cards.exUz: U aytgan hamma narsani yuzaki baholamang; u bo'rttirishga moyil.
cards.uzDef: Biron narsani shubhasiz qabul qilish; uning haqiqiyligini tekshirmasdan.

cards.ex: The country is in a precarious situation after the recent political unrest.
cards.exUz: Yaqinda bo'lib o'tgan siyosiy tartibsizliklardan so'ng mamlakat xavfli vaziyatda.
cards.uzDef: Qulay emas, xavfli yoki beqaror vaziyat.

cards.ex: The company is always looking to push the envelope with its innovative designs.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya doimo innovatsion dizaynlari bilan chegarani oshirishga intiladi.
cards.uzDef: Mavjud chegaralarni buzish orqali imkoniyatlarni kengaytirish.

cards.ex: We didn't have much time to prepare, so we had to fly by the seat of our pants.
cards.exUz: Tayyorgarlik ko'rishga vaqtimiz kam edi, shuning uchun biz tajribamizga tayanib ish qilishimiz kerak edi.
cards.uzDef: Rejalashtirmasdan yoki bilimga ega bo'lmasdan vaziyatni boshqarish.

cards.ex: By lying to the boss, he's playing with fire and could lose his job.
cards.exUz: Boshliqqa yolg'on gapirib, u olov bilan o'ynamoqda va ishini yo'qotishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Xavfli yoki oqibatlari bo'lishi mumkin bo'lgan harakatlarni qilish.

cards.ex: The library is a safe haven for students who need a quiet place to study.
cards.exUz: Kutubxona o'qish uchun tinch joyga muhtoj bo'lgan talabalar uchun xavfsiz joydir.
cards.uzDef: Xavf yoki muammolardan himoyalangan joy.

cards.ex: Her extravagant spending habits raised eyebrows among her colleagues.
cards.exUz: Uning haddan tashqari sarf-xarajatlari hamkasblari orasida shubha uyg'otdi.
cards.uzDef: Shubha, norozilik yoki qiziqish uyg'otmoq.

cards.ex: Starting his own business was a leap of faith, but he believed in his idea.
cards.exUz: O'z biznesini boshlash ishonch qadami edi, lekin u o'z g'oyasiga ishondi.
cards.uzDef: Dalil bo'lmasa ham, nimagadir ishonish uchun tavakkal qilish.

cards.ex: After losing his job, he found himself in dire straits.
cards.exUz: Ishini yo'qotgandan so'ng, u o'zini og'ir ahvolda topdi.
cards.uzDef: Juda yomon yoki umidsiz vaziyatda.

cards.ex: He tried to cover his tracks, but the police eventually found out the truth.
cards.exUz: U izini yashirishga harakat qildi, ammo politsiya oxir-oqibat haqiqatni bilib oldi.
cards.uzDef: Noto'g'ri ish qilganingizni hech kim bilmasligi uchun harakat qilmoq.

cards.ex: His comments about poverty were close to home for many people in the audience.
cards.exUz: Uning kambag'allik haqidagi izohlari tomoshabinlarning ko'pchiligi uchun yurakka yaqin edi.
cards.uzDef: Shaxsiy va ta'sirchan; qabul qilish qiyin bo'lishi mumkin.

cards.ex: I'm going out on a limb here, but I think we should invest in this new technology.
cards.exUz: Men bu yerda tavakkal qilmoqdaman, lekin menimcha, biz ushbu yangi texnologiyaga sarmoya kiritishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Boshqalardan farqli fikrni qo'llab-quvvatlash orqali o'zingni xavf ostiga qo'yish.

cards.ex: The near-fatal accident was a wake-up call for him to change his lifestyle.
cards.exUz: O'limga yaqin baxtsiz hodisa uning turmush tarzini o'zgartirish uchun ogohlantiruvchi signal bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsaning jiddiyligini tushunishga yordam beradigan voqea.

cards.ex: The peace talks are in jeopardy after the recent violence.
cards.exUz: Yaqinda bo'lgan zo'ravonliklardan so'ng tinchlik muzokaralari xavf ostida.
cards.uzDef: Yo'qotish yoki xavfga qo'yilishi mumkin bo'lgan vaziyatda.

cards.ex: His job is on the line if he doesn't improve his performance.
cards.exUz: Agar u ish faoliyatini yaxshilamasa, uning ishi xavf ostida.
cards.uzDef: Yo'qotilishi yoki xavfga qo'yilishi mumkin bo'lgan narsa.

cards.ex: When push comes to shove, I know I can count on my friends for support.
cards.exUz: Vaziyat keskinlashganda, men do'stlarimning yordamiga ishonishimni bilaman.
cards.uzDef: Vaziyat qiyinlashganda yoki qiyin qaror qabul qilish kerak bo'lganda.

cards.ex: The company experienced a major security breach, compromising customer data.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya katta xavfsizlik buzilishiga duch keldi, bu esa mijozlar ma'lumotlariga putur yetkazdi.
cards.uzDef: Xavfsizlik tizimining ruxsatsiz kirish yoki buzilish holati.
